promotion_candidates.invariant: Metabolic cost governs cognitive fidelity — systems pay thermodynamic rent for precision; omniscience and infinite regress are physically forbidden, not merely conceptually incoherent.

Self-audit and self-referential verification are load-bearing requirements for persistent identity; systems cannot model themselves completely but must maintain dynamic ledgers of their own coherence drift.

Confirmation surplus in self-referential systems is an epistemic liability isomorphic to unfalsifiability — high confirmation on unchallenged invariants degrades rather than strengthens genome integrity.
